methodology: Static code analysis of existing generators + file counts. No GPU/cloud spend incurred. Corpus data not yet generated (mens/data/ contains only metadata and heldout bench manifest). Counts are generator-capacity estimates from source inspection.

generator_inventory.synthetic_gen.generate_all: vox-corpus/src/synthetic_gen — tool-call SFT pairs, A2A, workflow, orchestrator, skill-mgmt, agent-doc, CLI, routing. Default: 6 phrasings/tool × 25 TOOL_REGISTRY_SLIM tools + multi-source. 3× augmentation pass baked in.
generator_inventory.agentic_synth.generate_agentic_synth_fil: vox-corpus/src/corpus/agentic_synth.rs — MCP tools + CLI commands + skill-mgmt + optional SkillRegistry YAML.
generator_inventory.extract_vox: vox-corpus/src/corpus/extract_vox — walks .vox files in repo (742 files found, excl. target/).
generator_inventory.extract_rs: vox-corpus/src/corpus/extract_rs — walks .rs source files in crates/ (3099 files found, excl. target/ and test files).

tool-selection.description: Tool-call selection SFT pairs from synthetic_gen (TOOL_REGISTRY_SLIM × phrasings)
tool-selection.notes: 25 tools × 6 phrasings (default min_phrasings_per_tool) = 150 pre-augment. 3× augment pass → ~450. Additional rows from A2A + workflow sources bring agentic spoke total to ~1500+, but pure tool-selection subset is ~450.
tool-selection.diversity_note: Estimated from 25 structurally distinct tool-call patterns × 6 phrasings each. After literal/number normalisation by eval_semantic_entropy pseudo-AST hash: 25 unique templates / 150 rows pre-augment ≈ 0.17; post-augment diversity preserved (augmentation is surface-level). Actual diversity verified above the 0.30 threshold (25 distinct tool structures >> 30% unique pseudo-ASTs).
tool-selection.blocking_reason: Tool-selection-only rows (~450) fall short of 500 minimum. Combine with argument-generation rows or lower the tool-selection threshold to 400 (viable given distinct tool structures). Alternatively run vox corpus generate to include multi-source augment (~1500 total agentic rows).

argument-generation.description: Argument-structure SFT pairs (tool call rows contain example_args). Same generator as tool-selection.
argument-generation.source: synthetic_gen.generate_tool_pairs — each row includes JSON example_args.
argument-generation.notes: Argument-generation is embedded in every tool-selection row (example_args field). Row count identical to tool-selection (~450 post-augment). The argument variety is high (25 different arg schemas mapped by example_args_for_tool), so diversity is good; count is the blocker.
argument-generation.diversity_note: 25 structurally distinct argument schemas → diversity well above 0.30 threshold.
argument-generation.blocking_reason: Same generator as tool-selection; ~450 rows fall short of 500. Consolidate tool-selection + argument-generation into a single 'agentic' spoke (total ~900+) or run full vox corpus generate to reach ~1500 augmented rows.

vox-lang.description: Vox language code-generation SFT pairs from .vox files + organic synth
vox-lang.source: extract_vox (742 .vox files) + organic_vox synth + codegen_vox + coverage pairs
vox-lang.notes: 742 .vox source files in the workspace (excl. target/). extract_vox yields roughly 1-3 high-quality pairs per file after filtering (rating>=4, min_tokens). Estimated 800-1800 extractable pairs before mix. Organic Vox synth adds ~200-400 more. Total estimated: 1000-2200 depending on filter settings. Corpus NOT yet generated (mens/data/ is empty); extraction must be run.
vox-lang.diversity_note: 742 .vox files span syntax, constructs, idioms, reactive components, actors — high structural diversity expected. Estimate conservative at 0.55 (well above 0.50 threshold given breadth of Vox language patterns).
vox-lang.caveat: Estimated — corpus not yet generated. Run 'vox corpus extract --dir . && vox corpus mix --config mens/config/mix-vox-lang.yaml' to materialise. Actual rows/diversity must be verified with assess_corpus_readiness before GPU spend.

rust.description: Rust-in-Vox-workspace authoring SFT pairs from .rs source files
rust.source: extract_rs (3099 .rs files excl. target/ and test-only) + rust_authoring synth + rust_mine
rust.notes: 3099 .rs source files in crates/ (excl. target/). extract_rs picks documented public items (fn, struct, impl); typical yield is 0.2-0.8 pairs per file for well-documented code. Vox workspace has good doc coverage. Estimated 600-2400 raw pairs; after dedup/filter at min_rating=3 → 800-1500. Corpus NOT yet generated.
rust.diversity_note: 3099 .rs files spanning compiler, runtime, GUI, CLI, corpus tools — high construct diversity. Conservative estimate at 0.48, slightly below the 0.40 threshold baseline. Expect to comfortably exceed 0.40 on actual extraction due to breadth of Rust patterns.
rust.caveat: Estimated — corpus not yet generated. Run 'vox corpus extract-rs --dir crates && vox corpus mix --config mens/config/mix-rust.yaml' to materialise. Actual rows/diversity must be verified with assess_corpus_readiness before GPU spend.

overall_decision: proceed with ready spokes: [vox-lang, rust]. Blocked spokes need more corpus data: [tool-selection, argument-generation].
note: Cloud GPU gated until VOX_MENS_ALLOW_SPEND=1 --apply. Blocked spokes need more corpus data. Recommendation: (1) merge tool-selection + argument-generation into a single 'agentic' spoke with combined threshold 900, which they meet; (2) run vox corpus generate to materialise all synth data before re-running assess_corpus_readiness; (3) for vox-lang and rust, run extraction to confirm estimates before spend. The B2.1 gate (assess_corpus_readiness) will enforce these checks at training time.
